content: Sɑnɑm mɛ Sɑmbɑlɑ kɑ Tobiyɑ kɑ Dɑɑrububɑ kɑ Amɔnibɑ kɑ Asidɔduɡibu bɑ nuɑ mɑ Yerusɑlɛmun ɡbɑ̃rɑ ten sɔmburɑ sĩimɔ, bɑ mɑɑ ten kuu dɑbinu kɔrumɔ, yerɑ bɑ mɔru bɛsirɑ too.
Mɑ bɑ nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ bu kɑ Yerusɑlɛmu wɔri kpɑ bu yen tɔmbu burisinɑ.
Yerɑ sɑ Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni kɑnɑ mɑ sɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ te kɔ̃su sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ kɑ wɔ̃kuru. Sɑ yibɛrɛ be mɑrɑ.
Adɑmɑ Yudɑbɑ bɑ ɡerumɔ bɑ mɔ̀,

content.text: ɡbɑ̃rɑ ten wɔrumɑɑn tem kusɑnu nu kpɑ̃
sere bɛsɛn sɔm kowobɑ wɑsirɑ kɑ nin ɡurɑbu.
Sɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ su tu bɑni.

content: Mɑ bɛsɛn yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ tɑmɑɑ sɑ ǹ ben bɑɑru nɔɔmɔwɑ, sɑ ǹ mɑɑ bu wɑsi sere dɔmɑ te bɑ koo sun wɔri bu ɡo kpɑ bu bɛsɛn sɔmbu te yɔ̃rɑsiɑ.
Nɛɛmi u tɔn be bɑ sɔmburu mɔ̀
tɑbu yɑ̃nu wɛ̃
Yuu be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn yibɛrɛbɑn suunu sɔɔ bɑ nɑ bɑ sun sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɔn dɑbinu kɑri ye yɑ wee sɑɑ yibɛrɛ ben min di kɑ sere mìn di bɑ koo sun wɔrimɑ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɑ tɔmbu tɑbu yɑ̃nu wɛ̃ ben bɑɑwure kɑ win tɑkobi kɑ win yɑɑsɑ kɑ win tɛndu. Mɑ nɑ bu yi yi bwese kɛrɑ kɑ bwese kɛrɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑrun biruɔ mi bɑ ǹ ɡinɑ bɑnɛ.

Mɑ nɑ seewɑ nɑ bukurobu kɑ siri kowobu kɑ tɔn be bɑ tie sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, i ku ben bɛrum ko. I yɑɑyo mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kpɑ̃. Wiyɑ bɑ koo nɑsiɑ. I tɑbu koowo bɛɛn mɛro bisibun sɔ̃ kɑ bɛɛn bibun sɔ̃ kɑ bɛɛn kurɔbun sɔ̃ kɑ sere bɛɛn yɛnusun sɔ̃.
Yen biru, bɛsɛn yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ nuɑ mɑ bɑ sun sɔ̃ɔwɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ kpuro. Gusunɔ u mɑɑ ben himbɑbɑ kɑm koosiɑ. Mɑ bɑɑwure u wurɑ mi u rɑɑ sɔmburu mɔ̀.
Sɑɑ dɔmɑ ten di, nɛn sɔm kowobun sukum mu rɑ n sɔmburu mɔ̀wɑ kpɑ be bɑ tie bɑ n yɑɑsi kɑ tɛrɛnu kɑ tɛnnu bɛki kpɑ bɑ n yɑbe tɑrɑkpenu doke. Kpɑ bɛsɛn wiruɡibu bɑ n sun dɑm kɛ̃mɔ.
Be bɑ mɑɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ te bɑnimɔ kɑ be bɑ kpenu ɡurɑmɔ, bɑ rɑ n nɔm teuɔ tɑbu yɑ̃nu nɛniwɑ kpɑ bɑ n kɑ teu sɔmburu mɔ̀.
Ben bɑɑwure u rɑ n win tɑkobi sɑ̃rusiewɑ pɔrɑɔ. Wi u rɑ kɔbɑ so, wiyɑ u rɑ n mɑn swĩi.
Mɑ nɑ bukurobu kɑ siri kowobu kɑ sere tɔn be bɑ tie mi sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, bɛsɛn sɔmbu te, tɑ kpɑ̃. Wee sɑ yɑrinɛ bɑɑmɑ kpuro. Goo kun kɑ ɡoo turuku ɡbɑ̃rɑ ten sɔmburu sɔɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, ì n kɔbɑn swĩi nuɑ, i mɛnnɑmɑ nɛn mi berɑ ɡee i yen swĩi yi nuɑ. Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni u koo sun sɑnnɑ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ sɑ kɑ sɔmbu te mɔ̀. Bɛsɛn sukum mu yɑɑsi nɛni sɑɑ bururun di sere kɑ wɔ̃kurɔ.
Nɑ mɑɑ wure nɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, bɑɑwure u kpunɔ Yerusɑlɛmun nukurɔ kɑ win sɔm kowobu kpɑ su dom se wɔ̃kuru sɑ n yibɛrɛbɑ mɑrɑ. Kpɑ su sɔmburu ko sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ.
Mɑ nɛ Nɛɛmi kɑ nɛn mɛro bisibu kɑ nɛn sɔm kowobu kɑ nɛn kɔ̃sobu be bɑ mɑn swĩi, bɛsɛ kpuro sɑ ǹ bɛsɛn yɑ̃nu potirɑ. Mɑ bɑɑwure u win tɑbu yɑ̃nu kɑ win nim nɛni.
Nɛɛmi u tɑki kpeesiɑ
